source: OpenStreetMap, read through the Overpass API (overpass-api.de)
name: OpenStreetMap
units: p: [latitude, longitude] in decimal degrees (WGS84), 6 decimals; h and w: metres as mapped; lv: building levels as mapped; counts and cut: number of shapes
note: buildings: the 2,500 nearest the middle are given, of 2,988 mapped. roads: the 2,500 busiest are given, of 3,940 mapped
